summary: Component P4 of plan pr-merge-latency-2026-10. Four PRs (#983, #984, #986, #997) spent 33 of 43 PR-hours to reach green because of reds that their change did not cause. (1) Retire or fix the stale ACS predicates that fail on main under -tags acs: acs/cycle43 (TestC43_002 needs go/cmd/evolve/cmd_phase_observer.go), acs/cycle813 (TestC813_001 wants an inline go test line in go.yml), acs/cycle1801 (TestC1801_004 references swarm.ExecReapOrphanSockets). title: PR merge latency P4: keep main green so a PR is not red for a cause outside its change
